entry.value: library(limma)%%00010%%00010knime.out <- tryCatch({%%00010%%00010 # -------------------------------------------------------------------------%%00010 # Helper functions%%00010 # -------------------------------------------------------------------------%%00010%%00010 parse_csv_variable <- function(x, variable_name, allow_none = TRUE) {%%00010%%00010 if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0L || is.na(x[1])) {%%00010 if (allow_none) {%%00010 return(NULL)%%00010 } else {%%00010 stop(sprintf("Flow variable '%s' is missing.", variable_name))%%00010 }%%00010 }%%00010%%00010 x <- trimws(as.character(x[1]))%%00010%%00010 if (allow_none && (x == "" || tolower(x) == "none")) {%%00010 return(NULL)%%00010 }%%00010%%00010 if (!allow_none && x == "") {%%00010 stop(sprintf("Flow variable '%s' is empty.", variable_name))%%00010 }%%00010%%00010 values <- trimws(strsplit(x, ",", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])%%00010%%00010 if (any(values == "")) {%%00010 stop(sprintf(%%00010 "Flow variable '%s' contains an empty value.",%%00010 variable_name%%00010 ))%%00010 }%%00010%%00010 values%%00010 }%%00010%%00010%%00010 validate_sample_vector <- function(values, variable_name, expected_length) {%%00010%%00010 if (!is.null(values) && length(values) != expected_length) {%%00010 stop(sprintf(%%00010 paste0(%%00010 "Flow variable '%s' contains %d values, ",%%00010 "but the input data contain %d sample columns."%%00010 ),%%00010 variable_name,%%00010 length(values),%%00010 expected_length%%00010 ))%%00010 }%%00010 }%%00010%%00010%%00010 # Adds a categorical nuisance factor as fixed effects.%%00010 #%%00010 # The first factor level is used as reference, avoiding creation of all%%00010 # dummy columns and reducing unnecessary rank-deficiency.%%00010 add_fixed_factor <- function(design, values, prefix) {%%00010%%00010 if (is.null(values)) {%%00010 return(design)%%00010 }%%00010%%00010 nuisance_factor <- factor(values)%%00010%%00010 if (nlevels(nuisance_factor) < 2L) {%%00010 message(sprintf(%%00010 "%s contains only one level and was therefore ignored.",%%00010 prefix%%00010 ))%%00010 return(design)%%00010 }%%00010%%00010 nuisance_design <- model.matrix(~ nuisance_factor)%%00010%%00010 # Remove the intercept column. The remaining columns represent all%%00010 # nuisance levels except the reference level.%%00010 nuisance_design <- nuisance_design[, -1L, drop = FALSE]%%00010%%00010 colnames(nuisance_design) <- paste0(%%00010 prefix,%%00010 "_",%%00010 make.names(levels(nuisance_factor)[-1L], unique = TRUE)%%00010 )%%00010%%00010 cbind(design, nuisance_design)%%00010 }%%00010%%00010%%00010 # eBayes normally calculates the moderated F-statistic only when the%%00010 # stored design is full rank. If the individual contrasts are estimable%%00010 # despite a rank-deficient original design, calculate the F-statistic%%00010 # explicitly using the same classifyTestsF procedure used by eBayes.%%00010 add_joint_F_statistics <- function(fit_object) {%%00010%%00010 if (!is.null(fit_object$F) &&%%00010 !is.null(fit_object$F.p.value)) {%%00010 return(fit_object)%%00010 }%%00010%%00010 F_statistic <- classifyTestsF(%%00010 fit_object,%%00010 fstat.only = TRUE%%00010 )%%00010%%00010 df1 <- attr(F_statistic, "df1")%%00010 df2 <- attr(F_statistic, "df2")%%00010%%00010 if (is.null(df1) || is.null(df2)) {%%00010 stop(%%00010 paste0(%%00010 "The joint moderated F-statistic could not be calculated. ",%%00010 "Check whether the supplied contrasts are estimable."%%00010 )%%00010 )%%00010 }%%00010%%00010 fit_object$F <- as.vector(F_statistic)%%00010%%00010 if (df2[1] > 1e6) {%%00010 fit_object$F.p.value <- pchisq(%%00010 df1 * fit_object$F,%%00010 df = df1,%%00010 lower.tail = FALSE%%00010 )%%00010 } else {%%00010 fit_object$F.p.value <- pf(%%00010 fit_object$F,%%00010 df1 = df1,%%00010 df2 = df2,%%00010 lower.tail = FALSE%%00010 )%%00010 }%%00010%%00010 fit_object%%00010 }%%00010%%00010%%00010 # -------------------------------------------------------------------------%%00010 # Input data and sample annotation%%00010 # -------------------------------------------------------------------------%%00010%%00010 data <- data.matrix(knime.in)%%00010%%00010 if (ncol(data) < 2L) {%%00010 stop("The input table must contain at least two sample columns.")%%00010 }%%00010%%00010 if (any(is.infinite(data), na.rm = TRUE)) {%%00010 stop("The input data contain infinite values.")%%00010 }%%00010%%00010 number_of_samples <- ncol(data)%%00010%%00010 groups_list <- parse_csv_variable(%%00010 knime.flow.in[["limma_design"]],%%00010 "limma_design",%%00010 allow_none = FALSE%%00010 )%%00010%%00010 validate_sample_vector(%%00010 groups_list,%%00010 "limma_design",%%00010 number_of_samples%%00010 )%%00010%%00010 pairs_list <- parse_csv_variable(%%00010 knime.flow.in[["samples_pairs"]],%%00010 "samples_pairs",%%00010 allow_none = TRUE%%00010 )%%00010%%00010 validate_sample_vector(%%00010 pairs_list,%%00010 "samples_pairs",%%00010 number_of_samples%%00010 )%%00010%%00010 blocks_list <- parse_csv_variable(%%00010 knime.flow.in[["samples_blocks"]],%%00010 "samples_blocks",%%00010 allow_none = TRUE%%00010 )%%00010%%00010 validate_sample_vector(%%00010 blocks_list,%%00010 "samples_blocks",%%00010 number_of_samples%%00010 )%%00010%%00010%%00010 # -------------------------------------------------------------------------%%00010 # Design matrix%%00010 # -------------------------------------------------------------------------%%00010%%00010 group_levels <- unique(groups_list)%%00010 safe_group_levels <- make.names(group_levels, unique = TRUE)%%00010%%00010 if (any(group_levels != safe_group_levels)) {%%00010%%00010 mapping <- paste(%%00010 sprintf("'%s' -> '%s'", group_levels, safe_group_levels),%%00010 collapse = ", "%%00010 )%%00010%%00010 stop(paste0(%%00010 "Sample-group names must be valid R coefficient names because ",%%00010 "they are used in LIMMA contrast expressions. Suggested names: ",%%00010 mapping%%00010 ))%%00010 }%%00010%%00010 factor_groups <- factor(%%00010 groups_list,%%00010 levels = group_levels%%00010 )%%00010%%00010 # One coefficient per experimental group.%%00010 design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + factor_groups)%%00010 colnames(design) <- group_levels%%00010%%00010 # Pairs and blocks are treated as additive fixed-effect nuisance factors.%%00010 design <- add_fixed_factor(%%00010 design,%%00010 pairs_list,%%00010 "Pair"%%00010 )%%00010%%00010 design <- add_fixed_factor(%%00010 design,%%00010 blocks_list,%%00010 "Block"%%00010 )%%00010%%00010%%00010 # -------------------------------------------------------------------------%%00010 # Design diagnostics%%00010 # -------------------------------------------------------------------------%%00010%%00010 design_rank <- qr(design)$rank%%00010 residual_df <- nrow(design) - design_rank%%00010%%00010 if (residual_df < 1L) {%%00010 stop(sprintf(%%00010 paste0(%%00010 "The design has no residual degrees of freedom: ",%%00010 "%d samples, design rank %d. ",%%00010 "There are too many pair/block coefficients for the ",%%00010 "available number of samples."%%00010 ),%%00010 nrow(design),%%00010 design_rank%%00010 ))%%00010 }%%00010%%00010 if (!is.fullrank(design)) {%%00010%%00010 non_estimable <- nonEstimable(design)%%00010%%00010 if (length(non_estimable) == 0L) {%%00010 non_estimable_text <- "not identified"%%00010 } else {%%00010 non_estimable_text <- paste(%%00010 non_estimable,%%00010 collapse = ", "%%00010 )%%00010 }%%00010%%00010 message(sprintf(%%00010 paste0(%%00010 "The design matrix is rank-deficient: rank %d of %d. ",%%00010 "Non-estimable coefficient(s): %s. ",%%00010 "LIMMA will continue, but only estimable contrasts can be used."%%00010 ),%%00010 design_rank,%%00010 ncol(design),%%00010 non_estimable_text%%00010 ))%%00010 }%%00010%%00010%%00010 # -------------------------------------------------------------------------%%00010 # Initial LIMMA fit%%00010 # -------------------------------------------------------------------------%%00010%%00010 fit <- lmFit(data, design)%%00010%%00010%%00010 # -------------------------------------------------------------------------%%00010 # Contrasts%%00010 # -------------------------------------------------------------------------%%00010%%00010 contrasts_list <- parse_csv_variable(%%00010 knime.flow.in[["contrasts"]],%%00010 "contrasts",%%00010 allow_none = FALSE%%00010 )%%00010%%00010 if (anyDuplicated(contrasts_list)) {%%00010 stop(sprintf(%%00010 "Duplicate LIMMA contrasts were specified: %s",%%00010 paste(%%00010 unique(contrasts_list[duplicated(contrasts_list)]),%%00010 collapse = ", "%%00010 )%%00010 ))%%00010 }%%00010%%00010 cont.matrix <- tryCatch(%%00010 makeContrasts(%%00010 contrasts = contrasts_list,%%00010 levels = design%%00010 ),%%00010 error = function(e) {%%00010 stop(paste0(%%00010 "The LIMMA contrast matrix could not be created. ",%%00010 "Available design coefficients are: ",%%00010 paste(colnames(design), collapse = ", "),%%00010 ". Original error: ",%%00010 conditionMessage(e)%%00010 ))%%00010 }%%00010 )%%00010%%00010 zero_contrasts <- colSums(abs(cont.matrix)) == 0%%00010%%00010 if (any(zero_contrasts)) {%%00010 stop(sprintf(%%00010 "The following contrasts evaluate to zero: %s",%%00010 paste(%%00010 colnames(cont.matrix)[zero_contrasts],%%00010 collapse = ", "%%00010 )%%00010 ))%%00010 }%%00010%%00010 contrast_rank <- qr(cont.matrix)$rank%%00010%%00010 if (contrast_rank < ncol(cont.matrix)) {%%00010 message(sprintf(%%00010 paste0(%%00010 "The %d specified contrasts have rank %d. ",%%00010 "Some contrasts are linearly dependent; the joint test ",%%00010 "will use the effective contrast rank."%%00010 ),%%00010 ncol(cont.matrix),%%00010 contrast_rank%%00010 ))%%00010 }%%00010%%00010%%00010 # -------------------------------------------------------------------------%%00010 # Contrast fit and empirical Bayes moderation%%00010 # -------------------------------------------------------------------------%%00010%%00010 fit2 <- tryCatch(%%00010 contrasts.fit(fit, cont.matrix),%%00010 error = function(e) {%%00010 stop(paste0(%%00010 "The requested contrast is not estimable with the current ",%%00010 "group/pair/block design. Original error: ",%%00010 conditionMessage(e)%%00010 ))%%00010 }%%00010 )%%00010%%00010 fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)%%00010%%00010 adjustment_method <- as.character(%%00010 knime.flow.in[["adjP_method"]]%%00010 )%%00010%%00010 comparisons_separately <- (%%00010 as.integer(knime.flow.in[["comparisons_separately"]]) == 1L%%00010 )%%00010%%00010%%00010 # -------------------------------------------------------------------------%%00010 # Output individual contrasts or a joint ANOVA-like test%%00010 # -------------------------------------------------------------------------%%00010%%00010 if (comparisons_separately) {%%00010%%00010 partial_results_list <- vector(%%00010 mode = "list",%%00010 length = ncol(cont.matrix)%%00010 )%%00010%%00010 for (i in seq_len(ncol(cont.matrix))) {%%00010%%00010 contrast_name <- colnames(cont.matrix)[i]%%00010%%00010 partial_result <- topTable(%%00010 fit2,%%00010 coef = i,%%00010 number = Inf,%%00010 sort.by = "none",%%00010 adjust.method = adjustment_method%%00010 )%%00010%%00010 # Explicit column prefixes make the output predictable in KNIME.%%00010 colnames(partial_result) <- paste(%%00010 contrast_name,%%00010 colnames(partial_result),%%00010 sep = "."%%00010 )%%00010%%00010 partial_results_list[[i]] <- partial_result%%00010 }%%00010%%00010 results <- do.call(%%00010 cbind,%%00010 partial_results_list%%00010 )%%00010%%00010 } else {%%00010%%00010 if (ncol(cont.matrix) < 2L) {%%00010 stop(%%00010 paste0(%%00010 "ANOVA-like joint testing requires at least two ",%%00010 "specified contrasts. Only one contrast was supplied."%%00010 )%%00010 )%%00010 }%%00010%%00010 # This is needed particularly when the original block-adjusted%%00010 # design is rank-deficient but the requested contrasts are estimable.%%00010 fit2 <- add_joint_F_statistics(fit2)%%00010%%00010 results <- topTable(%%00010 fit2,%%00010 coef = seq_len(ncol(cont.matrix)),%%00010 number = Inf,%%00010 sort.by = "none",%%00010 adjust.method = adjustment_method%%00010 )%%00010 }%%00010%%00010%%00010 as.data.frame(results)%%00010%%00010}, error = function(e) {%%00010%%00010 stop(%%00010 paste0(%%00010 "LIMMA KNIME snippet failed: ",%%00010 conditionMessage(e)%%00010 ),%%00010 call. = FALSE%%00010 )%%00010})
